hypothesis: one training-fold-fitted positive inverse temperature can improve V2 log-loss and ECE while mathematically preserving every row's known-action ranking

source.sufficient_statistics: V4 remote worker pickles, arm A only
source.final_v2_model_blocker: it has fitted hard counts but no component-separated held-out decision cells from which to produce leakage-free calibration rows

population.outer_fold_assignment: unchanged requested fold_count=5 and split_seed=20260911 component folds from V4

calibrator.outcome_space: known V2 action catalog plus the held-out unknown-action bucket
calibrator.ranking_scope: known executable action catalog; the unknown bucket remains evaluation-only
calibrator.rank_proof: q_i/q_j = (p_i/p_j)^beta; beta>0 preserves strict order and ties, so lexical tie-breaking and top1/top3 are unchanged

fit_protocol.method: within each outer training fold, leave one whole component out at a time, predict that component from the other outer-training components, then fit one beta to the pooled inner-OOF predictions
fit_protocol.three_component_limitation: each inner model trains on one component; retain this variance and do not change the protocol after seeing results
